question: When difference between compound and simple interest for three years is ₹124 at 10% interest per annum, the principal is ₹ ______
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective SI rate for 3 years at 10% = 10% × 3 = 30%

Effective CI rate for 3 years at 10% = 33.1%

Difference in effective rates = 33.1% − 30% = 3.1%

According to the given data, 3.1% ≡ ₹124

Principal (100%) = (124 ÷ 3.1) × 100 = ₹4000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rate (R) = 10% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

Difference between CI and SI = ₹124
